scoring_justification: The analytical quantities (grating period and insertion losses) can be independently recomputed from the public parameters using the paper's closed-form expressions.

schema.description: Single floating-point number in nm, at least two decimal places.

outputs.description: The grating period that satisfies the phase-matching conditions. Checker recomputes from the same analytical formulas and compares within a hidden tolerance.

schema.description: One row containing two floating-point numbers.

outputs.description: Insertion losses (dB) for the first- and second-order modes. Checker recomputes from the same analytical formulas and compares within a hidden tolerance.

output_contract.notes: Only the analytical slab-waveguide Example 1 with three TE modes is reproduced. The effective indices required for computing coupling coefficients are provided directly in the task instructions, so the agent does not need to solve the waveguide dispersion equation. FDTD simulations and TM-mode Example 2 are excluded.
